race.comment: Fantastic contest as always. Sticking with the progressive now four-year-old LEVERAGED BUYOUT (9). Dominated the three-year-olds including an effortless win in the NT Derby recently and can measure to take the Cup as well. STORMAGEDDON (2) is an SA visitor who charged home second-up here at weight-for-age over a mile to finish a close-up fourth. Ready for the extra ground now. CASINO SEVENTEEN (1) placed in the same race, finishing third. Extra trip a huge plus now and expected to go close. Hard to leave out the tough HADOUKEN (3) who is 3/3 this course and distance and has won this race the last two years. No doubt will be peaking for this again and has to be included. REMATCH (11) was beaten a head by VENTING here last time at the mile after winning that trip two back. In great form and expected to run well. Plenty of minor chances as well.
